title: Middle Eastern Roasted Veggie Bowl
subtitle: with Hummus
description: Ditch the white rice and dig into this grain bowl with hummus, roasted cauli and carrot instead. Freekeh is a super grain – it's high in protein and fibre, keeping you fuller for longer. It's freek-a-licious!

steps.text: Roast cauliflower: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the cauliflower into small florets. Combine half the hummus, 1 tsp zaatar, 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tbs water in a large bowl. Add the cauliflower and toss to coat. Put the cauliflower on the lined tray and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 22-25 mins until golden and tender.

Cook freekeh: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the eggs. Put the freekeh in a medium saucepan with 1L (4 cups) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, partially covered, for 15-18 mins until tender. Drain.
Boil eggs: Cook 2 eggs in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled, or 8 mins for hard-boiled, then remove from the pan and cool in cold water (see Did you know?).

Toss carrot and parsley: Meanwhile, peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Coarsely chop the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems. Put 1 tbs red wine vinegar, 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp honey in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the carrot and parsley leaves and stems and toss to combine.

Assemble and serve up: Peel and halve the eggs. Crush 1 garlic clove. Combine the garlic with the remaining hummus and 3 tsp boiling water. Divide the freekeh among bowls. Top with the carrot mixture, roasted cauliflower and egg. Drizzle over the hummus dressing, scatter over the remaining zaatar, then toss to combine. Enjoy!

Did you know?: Cooling the boiled eggs under cold running water, then transferring them to a bowl of cold water stops the cooking process. If you love your eggs soft-boiled, then don't skip this step or you'll end up with hard-boiled eggs instead!
